fn main() {
    print(number(1, 2, 3, 4))
}

fn number(a: Int, b: Int, c: Int, d: Int) -> Int {
    let ab = join(a, b)
    let cd = join(c, d)
    concat(concat(ab, cd), "1234")
}

fn join(a: Int, b: Int) -> Str {
    concat(str_from_int(a), str_from_int(b))
}

fn str_from_int(n: Int) -> Str {
    chars(to_float(n))
}

fn concat(a: Str, b: Str) -> Str {
    let mut result = vec()
    for c in &a {
        push(result, c)
    }
    for c in &b {
        push(result, c)
    }
    result
}

fn push(v: Vec<Str>, x: Str) -> Vec<Str> {
    let mut v = v
    v = v + x
    v
}

fn chars(s: Str) -> Vec<Str> {
    let mut v = vec()
    for c in &s {
        v = push(v, c)
    }
    v
}
